text:
7 former Boonton High School athletes on college rosters for week ending Sept. 6
By
W. H. PaigeSeven former Boonton High School athletes are listed on college rosters for the week ending Sept. 6. Fifth-year Bella Viruet is with the East Stroudsburg field hockey program, which hosts St. Thomas Aquinas on Sept. 3.
All are field hockey players, representing Adelphi, Drew, East Stroudsburg, FDU-Florham, Mercyhurst, and SUNY Cortland. The teams have 13 scheduled events during the week ending Sept. 6.
Each athlete's college team and schedule appear below.
Former Boonton High School Athletes Scheduled for College Action — Week Ending September 6
Bella Viruet
East Stroudsburg field hockey — PSAC
Schedule: Hosts St. Thomas Aquinas on September 3 in East Stroudsburg, PA; Hosts Assumption on September 6 in East Stroudsburg, PA
Elaiana Rivera-Lagalla
East Stroudsburg field hockey — PSAC
Schedule: Hosts St. Thomas Aquinas on September 3 in East Stroudsburg, PA; Hosts Assumption on September 6 in East Stroudsburg, PA
Tayla Szmak
Adelphi field hockey — NE-10
Schedule: Hosts Kutztown University on September 3 in Garden City, NY; Hosts West Chester University on September 6 in Garden City, NY
Elizabeth Harbeson
Drew field hockey — Landmark
Schedule: Hosts Neumann University on September 1 in Madison, NJ; Hosts Kean University on September 5 in Madison, NJ
Sidney Figueroa
FDU-Florham field hockey — MAC Freedom
Schedule: Visits Immaculata on September 2 in Immaculata, PA; Hosts Western Connecticut State on September 5 in Madison, NJ
Ani Myers
Mercyhurst field hockey — PSAC
Schedule: Visits Saint Louis on September 6 in Saint Louis, MO
Kaylee Hughen
SUNY Cortland field hockey — SUNYAC
Schedule: Visits Montclair St. on September 1 in Montclair, NJ; Hosts Haverford on September 5 in Cortland, NY
